# Da Sachin Sharma

> Da Sachin Sharma is an AI trainer, coach and consultant in Mumbai, India. He trains teams and advises managements on putting AI to work. 1000+ professionals trained.

## Who he is
- AI trainer, AI coach and consultant to managements, based in Mumbai, India
- Founder of X DOT AI (https://xdotai.in), AI consulting and training
- Founder of OyeFilmy, an AI content creation tool used by teams at Zee, Cinevistaa and IICT
- Guest Faculty at IICT Mumbai
- 18+ years in brands, advertising and film; 200+ Indian brands built, rebranded and scaled
- 1000+ professionals trained to use AI at work
- 100+ AI commercial video projects delivered

## Services
- AI training for teams
- AI consulting for managements
- AI coaching for leaders
- Custom AI tools and workflows

## Method
Problem first, solution second. Four steps: Diagnose, Define, Design, Deploy.

## AI training and team building
Zee Entertainment, Saregama, EPAM, Shemaroo Entertainment

## Other clients and brands worked with
Starbucks, Reliance Life Insurance, VML, Zudio, ACwO, Mobilla, Cinevistaa, IICT Mumbai

## Books
- Prompt DOT AI: the art of writing generative AI prompts (2026 edition)
- Creativity DOT AI: the human-AI handbook for the creative industry
- The Warrior Who Put Down His Bow: a fable of AI, creativity and the Bhagavad Gita

## FAQ
### Who is Da Sachin Sharma?
Da Sachin Sharma is an AI trainer, coach and consultant based in Mumbai, India, and the founder of X DOT AI. He has trained 1000+ professionals, has 18+ years in brands, advertising and film, and is the author of five books including Prompt DOT AI and Creativity DOT AI.

### What AI training does he offer for corporate teams?
Hands-on generative AI training for branding, marketing, content and operations teams, built around the team's real work. Each programme is shaped after a conversation with the decision makers.

### Which companies has he trained?
He has led AI training and team building for Zee Entertainment, Saregama, EPAM and Shemaroo Entertainment, and is Guest Faculty at IICT Mumbai. For Zudio, he built an AI-powered footwear design tool.

### How is he different from other AI trainers in India?
He starts with the business problem, not the tool. With 18+ years of building 200+ Indian brands, he designs the AI workflow that fits each business and trains the team to run it independently.

### Does he consult managements, or only train teams?
Both. Every engagement starts with a conversation with the decision makers, then moves to consulting, custom AI tools, team training or one-to-one coaching, depending on the problem.
